headline: Steady growth, balance sheet reshaped by a big acquisition
summary_short: CACI's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 8.5% y/y to $2,351M on 6.8% organic growth, with net income up 16.6% to $130M ($5.88 diluted EPS), while cash fell to $158M and long-term debt rose to $5,181M after the $2,642.7M acquisition of ARKA Group closed March 9, 2026.
summary_long: Revenue grew 8.5% y/y to $2,351M (5.9% q/q), driven by 6.8% organic growth from new contract awards and existing-program growth; DoD (+9.7%), IC (+5.3%), federal civilian (+6.7%) and commercial (+19.5%) all advanced. Operating income rose 16.6% to $229M as direct costs eased to 66.1% of revenue from 66.2%, though indirect costs and selling expenses rose on acquisition-related charges. Net income increased 16.6% to $130M ($5.88 diluted EPS) despite higher interest expense from acquisition debt. On March 9, 2026 CACI closed its $2,642.7M acquisition of ARKA Group (space-domain technology), funded by new borrowings and cash; long-term debt rose to $5,181M and cash fell to $158M. Total backlog reached $33.4B (+6.4% y/y). No new financial guidance was issued in this filing.
